visualStyleNotes: Data And Statistics, Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A shelf of value blocks, a sorted track where sorting slides them into order, and a glowing median marker. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (amber / molecular-green / grid-blue from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Blocks: numbered warm paper cubes (roughness ~0.5). Shelf: warm paper panel. Sorted track: soft warm-grey rail. Median marker: a small amber glow-cue plate under the middle block. Even-count pairing: two blocks light together. Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). No emissive channels — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: the median as the middle of sorted data — five unbalanced blocks sort onto a rail; the middle block glows; 'add block' switches to even-count averaging; dragging a block very high leaves the median unmoved.

GEOMETRY: A shelf with a messy row of five numbered blocks (3, 7, 1, 5, 2) plus an empty sorted track. 'Sort' slides blocks into low-to-high order on the track; the middle block glows as the median. 'Add block' inserts a sixth block — the two middle blocks highlight and a small slider averages them. Dragging the largest block to a huge number animates it growing at the far end while the median marker stays fixed.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) shelf; (2) messy row; (3) sorted track; (4) median marker + pairing.

CAMERA: three-quarter from front-left, slightly above, frames shelf and track; labels legible. Budget 5-9k triangles. Named nodes: Shelf, MessyRow, SortedTrack, Blocks, MedianMarker, AddBlockBtn, PairHighlight. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
